description: Create a custom guided camera tour, a scripted walk or fly-through that share links can play. Use it when the user wants a specific route, order of rooms or framing; for a good tour without choosing a route, use reset_auto_camera_path. Parameters: keyframes use scene metres with y up. Every key needs a non-zero forward vector `f`; add `look` to keep a target point centred, which takes over aiming at that key. Keys without `dur` are timed from `speed`; `hold` pauses at a key, which suits a room reveal. In 'walk' mode the camera keeps eye height and steers around walls, so put keys in open floor space; 'fly' moves freely and suits exteriors. Limits: 2 to 256 keys per tour and up to 24 tours per scene. Each call adds a new tour and keeps the others; the first tour on a scene becomes the default unless another is. Owner only. Requires sign-in (connector sign-in, or VERSE_API_KEY for the local server).

keys.description: Keyframes in order; the camera moves through them from first to last.

dur.description: Seconds to the next key (auto if omitted).

ease.description: Motion into this key: 'smooth' (default) eases through, 'stop' comes to rest, 'linear' keeps constant speed.

f.description: Forward direction [x,y,z], required and non-zero; need not be normalised. When `look` is set, the camera aims at that point instead.

fov.description: Vertical field of view in degrees at this key (default 60).

make_default.description: Make this the tour that share links and autoplay use.

mode.description: 'walk' keeps eye height over the floor and avoids walls; 'fly' goes anywhere.

name.description: Tour name shown to viewers, e.g. 'Ground floor walkthrough'.

scene.description: Scene id (e.g. palm-villa-0a1b2c3d4e5f), the job id returned by upload_scene, or a Verse share link.

speed.description: Metres per second for keys without `dur`.

name: set_camera_path

default.description: Whether links now play this tour by default.

tourLink.description: Link that opens the scene playing this tour.

title: Create a camera path (guided tour)
